key_idea: Iteratively apply local Ricci flow existence on shrinking domains, using the curvature pinching condition to establish an a priori curvature bound that allows extending the flow for a geometrically increasing sequence of times.
reason: The proof elegantly bypasses the lack of initial curvature bounds by interleaving spatial shrinking with time extensions, summing to a uniform lower bound on existence time. While the induction requires careful bookkeeping of constants and domains, the overall structure and reliance on geometric blow-up limits make it a highly conceptual and satisfying argument.
recognized: Man-Chun Lee and Peter Topping, Hamilton's pinching conjecture
